text: Remote Deck 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 SSH 远程开发插件，可将多台 SSH 主机上的目录接入为 DSH 工作区。插件通过 SFTP 将工作区文件操作路由到远端，并提供远程 bash 工具、搜索、交互式终端和端口转发；侧栏还显示远程连接状态、工作区和会话标识。它适合需要在 DSH 对话中直接处理远端代码或服务器项目的开发者。使用前需要可登录的 SSH 主机及相应认证信息；远程命令使用 bash。

Remote Deck connects SSH hosts as DSH workspaces. It routes file access over SFTP and provides remote bash, search, terminals, and port forwarding, with connection and session details in the sidebar. For developers working on remote projects from DSH. Requires an SSH host and credentials.
我想让 DSH 直接操作 SSH 服务器上的项目文件。
能不能把远程 Linux 目录当成普通工作区使用？
我需要在 DSH 会话里连接多台开发机并运行命令。
怎么在远端项目里开终端并转发本地端口？
I want to browse and edit files on an SSH host from my DSH workspace.
How can I run a terminal and forward a remote development port through SSH?
Remote Deck 的功能「远程工作区」：把 SSH 主机上的目录登记为 DSH 工作区，工作区路径下的文件操作通过 SFTP 映射到远端路径。创建工作区时选择连接和远端目录。
Remote Deck 的功能「远程命令」：在远程工作区中调用 bash 工具即可在对应主机执行 shell 命令，并返回标准输出、错误输出和退出码。
Remote Deck 的功能「交互式终端」：用户可在连接的主机上打开 SSH PTY、输入命令并调整终端尺寸；断线重连页面可重放有限长度的终端输出缓冲。
Remote Deck 的功能「端口转发」：用户选择远程主机上的端口后，可在本机回环地址创建转发监听，并通过 SSH 通道传输连接；已保存的转发可在主机重新连接后恢复。
我想从 DSH 搜索远程服务器上的代码。
希望远程主机的项目文件能直接出现在 DSH 工作区里。

dsh-remote-deck README · Remote Deck：**SSH workspaces for DeepSeek Harness — one window, local and remote conversations side by side.**

Remote Deck connects your DSH desktop app to any number of SSH machines and turns a remote
folder into an ordinary DSH workspace. Inside that workspace the agent reads, writes, searches,
runs commands, opens a terminal and forwards ports on the remote host — while the UI stays the
same window you already use.

dsh-remote-deck README · Remote Deck：- **Conversation first.** A compact status chip, a few badges, and a console that only appears
  when you open it. Nothing competes with the chat.
- **Many machines at once.** Every host has a colour identity, its own connection, and its own
  group of workspaces and sessions.
- **No agent on the server.** Only `sshd`: SFTP for files, exec channels for commands and search,
  a PTY for the terminal, `direct-tcpip` for port forwarding.

dsh-remote-deck README · Features：| Area | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| Connections | Multiple hosts, key or password auth, `~/.ssh/config` import, connection test with OS/latency, per-host auto-connect (off by default; toggle in the dialog, quick panel or console), keepalive and backoff reconnect |
| Workspaces | Browse remote folders with breadcrumbs, filters and keyboard navigation; add one as a DSH workspace; custom sidebar name; remove locally without touching the remote directory |
| Sessions | Remote sessions get a header pill, a colour-coded sidebar badge and a hover line; local sessions are unchanged |
| Console | Machine rail, host overview, stats, workspace cards, recent sessions, search, and a remote file browser with download / save-to-local / reveal |
| Terminal | Remote PTY in a full xterm.js terminal: colours, cursor, full-screen programs, paste and replay buffer |
| Ports | Automatic discovery of remote listening ports, one-click forwarding, persistence and restore on reconnect |
| Theme | Light and dark, driven by DSH theme tokens |

dsh-remote-deck README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/dsh-plugins-cn/dsh-remote-deck.git
cd dsh-remote-deck
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

Restart DSH (or press `Ctrl+R`) after installing; the SSH chip appears at the bottom of the
sidebar and **远程开发** appears in the sidebar navigation.

dsh-remote-deck README · Install：The plugin has **no npm dependencies**: `ssh2` and its small dependency tree are vendored under
`vendor/node_modules`, and the terminal assets under `vendor/xterm`. Installation therefore never
runs package build scripts.

dsh-remote-deck README · Migrating from `dsh-remote-ssh`：Remote Deck is the successor of `dsh-remote-ssh`.

- On first load it copies connections from `<DSH_HOME>/remote-ssh` and **reuses existing workspace
  stubs in place**, so workspaces and sessions keep their place in the sidebar.
- The old plugin keeps working until you remove it. Use one profile at a time: both plugins patch
  `ctx.fs`, so only one of them should be enabled in a profile.
- Cut over in one command (backs up `package.json` first and keeps the old plugin files for
  rollback):

dsh-remote-deck README · Migrating from `dsh-remote-ssh`：```powershell
  .\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -RemoveOld
  ```

- Roll back at any time:

```powershell
  .\install.ps1 -Rollback                 # restores package.json.bak-before-deck
  ```

Data stays in `<DSH_HOME>/remote-deck` and survives plugin reinstalls.

dsh-remote-deck README · How it works：```text
┌────────────────────────────── DSH desktop ──────────────────────────────┐
│ conversation · sidebar · Remote Deck console                            │
│        │ ctx.fs / ctx.shell / ripgrep / tools                            │
│        ▼                                                                │

dsh-remote-deck README · How it works：A remote workspace is a marked stub directory under `<DSH_HOME>/remote-deck/workspaces`; the
marker records the connection id and the remote POSIX path. Every path under a marked workspace
resolves through SFTP; commands run through an exec channel with the remote cwd; ripgrep moves to
the host; the terminal is one PTY channel; forwarding is one local listener per port.

dsh-remote-deck README · Security：- Passwords and key passphrases live in the DSH credential store, never in `connections.json`.
- The browser half talks to the host over a loopback HTTP server guarded by a per-session token.
- The terminal and forwarding endpoints are behind the same token.
- Removing a workspace only unregisters it locally; remote files are never deleted by the plugin.

dsh-remote-deck README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.x or newer.
- Node 20+.
- `sshd` on the remote host; Linux or macOS; remote shell `bash`.

dsh-remote-deck README · Known limits：- The terminal ships a vendored xterm.js build (colours, cursor, full-screen programs). If the
  asset loader is blocked, the plugin falls back to a plain line renderer.
- The UI is Chinese-first; English strings land in v1.1.0.
- `~/.ssh/config` import covers Host/HostName/Port/User/IdentityFile/ProxyJump; proxy commands and
  host-key pinning are not wired into the connection dialogs yet.
- `ss` or `netstat` is required for automatic port discovery; manual forwarding still works.

dsh-remote-deck README · Development：```sh

npm test             # parser unit tests
npm run pack:dry     # inspect the published file list
```

dsh-remote-deck README · Remote Deck · 远程工作台：**给 DeepSeek Harness 的 SSH 工作区插件：一个窗口，本地对话与远程对话并存。**

把任意一台 SSH 机器接进 DSH，把远端目录变成普通工作区。在这个工作区里，模型读写文件、
搜索、执行命令、开终端、转发端口，全部发生在远端；界面还是你现在这个窗口。

- **对话优先**：只有一个状态胶囊、几处标识；控制台点开才出现，不抢主界面。
- **多机并行**：每台机器一个颜色身份、一条独立连接、一组自己的工作区与会话。
- **远端零安装**：只用 `sshd`——SFTP 读文件、exec 通道跑命令与搜索、PTY 开终端、
  `direct-tcpip` 做端口转发。

dsh-remote-deck README · 能力：| 模块 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 连接 | 多机器、密钥/密码、`~/.ssh/config` 导入、测试连接（系统/延迟）、按机器自动连接（默认关闭，可在对话框/快速面板/控制台切换）、keepalive + 退避重连 |
| 工作区 | 面包屑浏览、筛选、键盘操作、自定义侧栏名、添加/移除（不删远端目录） |
| 会话标识 | 头部机器胶囊、侧栏彩色徽标、悬停卡远程路径；本地会话保持原样 |
| 控制台 | 机器栏、主机概览、指标、工作区卡片、最近会话、搜索，以及远程文件浏览/下载/本地定位 |
| 终端 | 完整 xterm.js 终端：颜色、光标、全屏程序，键盘/Ctrl 组合/粘贴，重连缓冲 |
| 端口 | 自动发现监听端口、一键转发、持久化、连接恢复后重建 |
| 主题 | 浅色/深色，跟随 DSH 主题 |

dsh-remote-deck README · 安装：插件市场上架后（或 npm 发布后）：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-remote-deck
```

直接从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/dsh-plugins-cn/dsh-remote-deck.git
```

国内网络可走 GitHub 代理：

```sh
dsh plugin add "git+https://ghproxy.laiyouxi.com/https://github.com/dsh-plugins-cn/dsh-remote-deck.git"
```

从源码安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/dsh-plugins-cn/dsh-remote-deck.git
cd dsh-remote-deck
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

dsh-remote-deck README · 安装：装完重启 DSH（或窗口里按 `Ctrl+R`），侧栏底部出现 **SSH** 胶囊，导航里出现 **远程开发**。

插件**没有任何 npm 依赖**：`ssh2` 及其依赖内置在 `vendor/node_modules`，终端资源在
`vendor/xterm`。安装过程不会执行任何构建脚本。

dsh-remote-deck README · 从 dsh-remote-ssh 迁移：- 首次加载会把 `<DSH_HOME>/remote-ssh` 的连接复制过来，并**原地复用**已有工作区，
  侧栏位置、会话归属都不变。
- 旧插件在卸载前一直可用；**同一个 profile 不要同时启用两个**（都会接管 `ctx.fs`）。
- 一条命令切换（会先备份 `package.json`，旧插件文件保留以便回滚）：

```powershell
  .\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -RemoveOld
  ```

- 一键回滚：

```powershell
  .\install.ps1 -Rollback                 # 还原 package.json.bak-before-deck
  ```

插件数据在 `<DSH_HOME>/remote-deck`，重装不丢。

dsh-remote-deck README · 原理：```text
┌────────────────────────────── DSH 桌面 ─────────────────────────────────┐
│ 对话 · 侧栏 · Remote Deck 控制台                                        │
│        │ ctx.fs / ctx.shell / ripgrep / tools                           │
│        ▼                                                                │

远程工作区是 `<DSH_HOME>/remote-deck/workspaces` 下带标记文件的目录，标记记录连接 id 和远端
POSIX 路径。落在标记目录下的路径走 SFTP；命令走带远端 cwd 的 exec 通道；ripgrep 移到远端；
终端是一条 PTY；每个转发是一个本地监听。

dsh-remote-deck README · 安全：- 密码、私钥口令存 DSH 凭据库，不写进 `connections.json`。
- 浏览器半通过带回环 token 的本地 HTTP 与 host 通信；终端与转发接口同样受 token 保护。
- 移除工作区只取消本地注册，插件从不删除远端文件。

dsh-remote-deck README · 要求：- DSH 桌面版 0.2.x 及以上；Node 20+。
- 远端有 `sshd`，支持 Linux / macOS，远端 shell 为 `bash`。

dsh-remote-deck README · 已知限制：- 终端内置 xterm.js（颜色、光标、全屏程序）；如果资产加载被拦截，会回退为纯文本行渲染。
- 界面目前中文优先，英文文案在 v1.1.0。
- `~/.ssh/config` 导入覆盖 Host/HostName/Port/User/IdentityFile/ProxyJump；代理命令与
  known_hosts 固定还没接进连接对话框。
- 自动端口发现依赖 `ss` 或 `netstat`；手动转发不受影响。
